name: platform-deployment
title: Where the platform runs
subtitle: Individual workload resources inside their host/runtime boundaries. Replicas belong to their workload; they are not additional physical machines.

panels.title: CPU VM · Docker containers and jobs

lines: CPU disks: 50 GiB boot, 500 GiB data, 150 GiB scratch
One box is one workload or client process.
Frameworks and SDKs stay inside the workload that uses them.
Supporting controllers/databases remain in their source manifests.

footer: Selected recorded workloads. Private UI viewers verify gateway HTTPS after the loopback/IAP hop. Single CPU control/data host; no cross-host control-plane HA or uninterrupted GPU rollout is established.

footer: The shared generation path is drawn once; all roles use it. Tool facts are checked independently of task completion. One control VM and one GPU worker do not establish host-level HA.
